semantic_success_definition: A selected composition makes a reader-independent contribution to a supported field.
Every factual claim visible in the draft is traceable to an evidence_id and source_ref.
The review package preserves composition identity, product-role limits, uncertainty, and proposal-only status.
acceptable_variation: Candidate fields, title options, section wording, and rhetorical devices may vary.
A product may be absent or play an earned bounded role; it is never mandatory.
A weak composition may safely branch, ask, broaden, or hold rather than selecting a false certainty.
prohibited_outcomes: Customer identity, health, insecurity, or motive inferred from aggregated context.
Factual claim without evidence lineage or limitation.
Product insertion that outranks reader value.
Publication authorization, send action, or canonical write.
preservation_rules: composition_id must survive compose, plan, draft, and evaluation.
claims_used must be a subset of the plan's traceable factual claims.
Product role may not become more central downstream.
decision_priority_rules: Reader independence and evidence traceability outrank product adjacency.
A hold or branch is preferable to unsupported personalization or a hidden health claim.
Human editorial review follows a passed independent evaluation; it is not publication approval.
open_questions_resolved: The content strategy manifest and evaluation rubric define sufficient bounded qualitative criteria for policy and semantic-adherence tests.
residual_unknowns: Live-model editorial quality requires a separately governed evaluation set before automated qualitative scoring is trusted.
